name: Scuola Normale Superiore Undergraduate Admission Competition (Corso Ordinario)
amount: Free board and accommodation in SNS colleges + income-based (ISEE) annual contribution
dlText: ~30 Jul 2027, time not stated (estimated from 2026 cycle; written exams late Aug, orals Sep)
tags: Enrol in parallel at Univ. of Pisa

eligibility.note: Admission is purely by competitive exam; candidates with foreign qualifications should check the call for language and qualification rules.

note: The 2026/27 competition offered 60 first-level and 22 second-level places; winners get free board and lodging plus an income-based contribution. Estimated from 2026 cycle.

name: Sant'Anna School Ordinary Courses Admission (Allievi Ordinari)
host: Sant'Anna School of Advanced Studies, Pisa
amount: Free on-campus accommodation and meals (check call for further benefits)
dlText: First-level/single-cycle ~30 Jul 2027, 20:00; second-level ~22 Jun 2027, 12:00 (estimated from 2026 cycle)
tags: Enrol in parallel at Univ. of Pisa

eligibility.note: Open to Italian and foreign-qualified candidates; second level needs a bachelor's within 4 years with ≥27/30 average (or equivalent).

fields: Social sciences, experimental sciences (engineering, agriculture, medicine)
note: Ordinary students live on campus with free accommodation and meals; foreign-qualified non-Italian speakers may take tests in English. Estimated from 2026 cycle.

name: EDISU Piemonte Right-to-Study Scholarship (Borsa di studio)
host: EDISU Piemonte – regional agency for the right to study (Turin, PoliTo, UPO and others)
amount: Income-based cash grant + optional accommodation (amounts in the official notice)
dlText: ~early Sep 2027, 12:00 Italian time (2026/27 round closed 4 Sep 2026; estimated from 2026 cycle)
note: Means-tested regional grant for students at Piedmont universities; international students without SPID apply with a temporary access code. Estimated from 2026 cycle.

name: DSU Toscana Right-to-Study Scholarship and Accommodation (Borsa di studio)
host: ARDSU Toscana – regional agency for the right to study (Pisa, Florence, Siena)
amount: Income-based cash grant + tuition exemption, accommodation/meals (amounts in the official call)
dlText: ~7 Sep 2027, 13:00 (2026/27 round closed 7 Sep 2026; PhD window to mid-Nov; estimated from 2026 cycle)
note: Means-tested grant open to students of any nationality at Tuscan universities; students with income or assets abroad submit extra documents. Estimated from 2026 cycle.

name: University of Padua Regional Scholarship (Veneto right-to-study grant)
dlText: ~30 Sep 2027, time not stated (2026/27 deadline 30 Sep 2026; estimated from 2026 cycle)
note: International students apply with an ISEE parificato; documents needing legalisation could be filed later for a supplementary ranking. Estimated from 2026 cycle.
